reports.title: Caris Life Sciences Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Increases 2026 Revenue Guidance

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook and Guidance
section: Caris Life Sciences now expects full year 2026 revenue to be in the range of $1.04 to $1.05 billion, representing growth of 28% to 29% compared to full year 2025 and reaffirms its guidance for clinical therapy selection volume growth of approximately 20% compared to full year 2025.
